title: Indian Hospitality
description: In India, the guest is treated as God — Atithi Devo Bhava. Warmth, food, and family that make strangers feel at home. #india #hospitality #culture #atithidevobhava

scenes.text: In India, there's an ancient saying. The guest is God.
Atithi Devo Bhava. A stranger is never turned away.
You'll be offered chai before you even sit down.
Fed until you simply cannot eat another bite.
Treated not like a visitor, but like family.
That warmth is the real heart of India.
